scope: Naked zero-argument parent get calls borrow This from an ordinary virtual Child get hook and select its lexical immediate Parent hook; Grand called scope and by-value return/throw cleanup are retained.

cases.source:
<?php
class ParentGetParent108 {
    private int $secret = 41;
    public int $value {
        get {
            global $child;
            echo 'P|', __CLASS__, '|', static::class, '|';
            $child = null;
            return $this->secret;
        }
    }
    public function __destruct() { global $rhs; echo 'D|'; $rhs = 99; }
}
class ParentGetChild108 extends ParentGetParent108 {
    private int $secret = 99;
    public int $value {
        get {
            echo 'C|';
            $copy = parent::$value::get();
            echo 'A|';
            return $copy;
        }
    }
}
class ParentGetGrand108 extends ParentGetChild108 {}
$rhs = 7;
$child = new ParentGetGrand108();
$result = 42;
echo 'N:';
$result = $child->value;
echo $result, '|', $rhs, '|E|';

<?php

        get {
            global $child, $error;
            echo 'P|';
            $child = null;
            throw $error;
        }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'D|'; }
}
class ParentGetChild108 extends ParentGetParent108 {
    public int $value {

            echo 'C|';

class ParentGetGrand108 extends ParentGetChild108 {}
$error = new Exception('supplied');
$child = new ParentGetGrand108();
$result = 42;
echo 'X:';
try { $result = $child->value; }
catch (Exception $caught) { echo $caught === $error ? 'C' : '!', '|'; }
echo $result, '|E|';

            $child = null;
            return new Exception('trace');
